# Yiolanti Maou

> Legal researcher, lecturer and dual-qualified practitioner. Adjunct Lecturer at the
> School of Law, University of Nicosia, and Associate Researcher of the University’s
> Procedural Law Unit. Advocate (Cyprus) and Solicitor of England and Wales.

Primary fields of research: private international law, and AI in judicial
decision-making. Secondary fields: civil procedure, international commercial
arbitration, and legal informatics.

## Pages

- [About](https://yiolantimaou.com/): biography, selected publications and upcoming talks, education,
  and bar admissions.
- [Research](https://yiolantimaou.com/research/): five research fields, each with a background and its
  ongoing projects.
- [Publications and Talks](https://yiolantimaou.com/publications/): four publications, and conference
  presentations grouped by year.
- [Teaching](https://yiolantimaou.com/teaching/): courses at the University of Nicosia School of Law,
  taught in English and Greek.
- [Contact](https://yiolantimaou.com/contact/): email, and an invitation to prospective supervisors and
  collaborators.
